design_brief.description: Create a simple cylindrical dry-cell battery model with specified outer diameter and overall length, suitable as a reference/space-claim part.

metadata.description: Simple cylindrical dry-cell battery reference model with positive terminal bump and flat negative end.

diameter_mm.description: Outer diameter of the battery body

length_mm.description: Overall length including positive terminal bump

positive_terminal_diameter_mm.description: Diameter of the positive terminal bump

positive_terminal_height_mm.description: Height of the positive terminal bump

negative_terminal_recess_mm.description: Optional shallow recess on the negative end (0 disables)

edge_fillet_radius_mm.description: Not used (minkowski/fillet operations are avoided for render safety)

overlap_mm.description: Small overlap to guarantee solid connectivity between parts

sketch.prompt:
Draw a clean, minimalistic orthographic technical line sketch of the described object on a white background. Use thin black lines only — no shading, no color, no photorealism, no perspective distortion. Keep proportions realistic. Show the front or three-quarter view that most clearly reveals all canonical parts of the object. If helpful, label key dimensions in millimeters with small arrows, but keep labels sparse. The sketch should look like a designer's concept drawing, suitable as a reference for a parametric CAD model.

OBJECT: A cylindrical dry-cell battery: 10.3 mm diameter, 28.5 mm length.
REQUIRED PARTS (must be visible in the sketch): battery_body, battery
PROPORTIONAL CONSTRAINTS — primary_dimension = 10mm (category: generic).
All other parts of the sketch must scale consistently with this total size — no exaggerated wheels, handles, or details.
APPROX DIMENSIONS: diameter_mm≈10.3mm, length_mm≈28.5mm, positive_terminal_diameter_mm≈4.0mm, positive_terminal_height_mm≈1.0mm, edge_fillet_radius_mm≈0.3mm
NOTE: If using the KB battery module, select/define a type matching 10.3 mm diameter and 28.5 mm length; otherwise model from primitives with the above parameters.

Keep the final image below 1024x1024, clean white background, no text outside the dimension labels, no watermark.
